tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Onyx black is the default for the website, reels end cards and ads; Daylight is for print, proposals and light sections.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: service cards, form fields, FAQ rows.

tokens.name: surface-high
tokens.usage: Hover state of a surface, nested panels, table header rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of an input.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and outlined (secondary) buttons. Holds 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on bg, surface and surface-high (17:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, captions, form labels on bg and surface (6.8:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The logo amber, sampled from the mark. Primary button fill, the play-triangle motif, one highlighted word per headline on onyx. Keep it to about 10% of any screen.

tokens.name: amber-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for amber buttons.

tokens.name: amber-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of amber buttons and large decorative blocks. Not for text.

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Amber used as TEXT: eyebrows, links, prices. On bg/surface: 9.3:1 dark, 5.6:1 light. Logo amber on white is only 2:1, so light theme uses the burnt value.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an amber fill (10:1). Never white on amber.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 3px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Form success messages, always with a word ('Sent'). Text on bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors, always paired with the message text. Text on bg.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline only, uppercase, expanded width. 56px on phones.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Card titles, case-study titles, page titles on inner pages.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: What a shoot day looks like

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: We film your crew on real jobs and turn it into a month of reels.
styles.usage: Hero subhead and section intros. Max 60 characters per line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: One shoot day covers four weeks of posts.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and nav links. Sentence/title case as written, never all caps.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headlines. The wide tracking echoes MEDIA in the logo.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timecodes, video specs, small metadata. Use sparingly as the 'film set' detail.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; heading to body.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between section header and content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: cards, images, video frames, sections. The brand is square and hard-edged like the wordmark.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs only, to soften the pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and the live REC dot. Nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: The system uses borders and contrast, not shadows. Use line or surface-high instead.
